about: Progress of a long engine call and Stop (DESIGN 5.12), alike on every host. The engine `Long` (engines/long, built to engines/long.wasm) uses only the service `progress`: the function of module `clarity` named `progress`, which takes two i64 (done, total) and gives nothing. `work(steps)` does a little work per step and reports `progress(step, steps)` after each; it gives the number of steps. A host hands every report to the call's progress sink, in order (the shell, not the host, sends at most ten a second to the screen). Stop is a flag the call is given: the host looks at it where it looks at the clock for the time limit, and once it is set the call fails with `engine <Name> failed in <function>: it was stopped`; set before the call, the call stops at once. `stopAt` is the report at which a test sets the flag (0: before the call). An engine with state drops its instance after a stopped call, as after any failure. `refused` is the message for an engine that imports `progress` without `uses progress`.
name: Long
